info.title: hippo
info.description: Indexes a markdown workspace into a local SQLite cache and answers structural questions about it.

x-inspectra.cliParsedDescription: Indexes a markdown workspace and answers structural questions about it.

commands.name: backrefs
commands.description: List the links into a path

options.name: --from
options.description: Only links from files matching this workspace-relative glob, or with a leading !, not matching it; repeatable

options.name: --transitive
options.description: Every file that reaches the path through a chain of links; --from and --link-kind apply at every hop

arguments.name: PATH
arguments.description: A path in the workspace, relative to the working directory: a file, a folder, or the workspace root; it need not exist, so links broken on it show; a folder's backrefs are the links to the folder itself, not to the files in it

commands.name: cache
commands.description: List the indexes in the cache, or remove those whose workspace is gone

commands.name: list
commands.description: List every index with its workspace root, state and size

commands.name: prune
commands.description: Remove the indexes of workspaces that were deleted, moved or renamed

options.name: --dry-run
options.description: List what would be removed, and remove nothing

options.name: --include-unreachable
options.description: Also remove indexes whose root cannot be reached, such as one on an unmounted drive

commands.name: find
commands.description: List indexed files in path order, or with a query, the pages holding every word and phrase of it, best match first, with a snippet of each

options.name: --glob
options.description: Only paths matching this workspace-relative glob, or with a leading !, not matching it; repeatable

options.name: --where
options.description: Only markdown files whose frontmatter field meets the condition: field=value, field!=value, field<value, field<=value, field>value, field>=value, field (present) or !field (missing); repeatable, and every condition must hold. A field is a dotted path, and a part ending in [] means each element of that list, as sources[].id=x. A value starting with @ names a field of the same page, as 'verified.at<@generated.at', and @@ writes a literal @; a value without a leading @ is always a literal. Numbers compare as numbers, anything else as text, so write dates as ISO 8601. Quote it for the shell, as --where 'as_of<2026-04-01'

options.name: --field
options.description: Show this frontmatter field of each file, a dotted path such as verified.at, or several separated by commas; repeatable. A part ending in [] means each element of that list, so sources[].resource shows the list of values. A list or mapping shows whole; keys holding ., ,, [ or ] cannot be reached

options.name: --errors
options.description: Only files whose frontmatter failed to parse, with the error

options.name: --no-refs
options.description: Only files with no link to another indexed file

options.name: --no-backrefs
options.description: Only files no other file links to

options.name: --from
options.description: With --no-backrefs, count only links from files matching this workspace-relative glob, or with a leading !, not matching it; repeatable

options.name: --link-kind
options.description: With --no-refs or --no-backrefs, count only links of this kind

options.name: --limit
options.description: At most this many results (20 by default with a query)

arguments.name: QUERY
arguments.description: Words every page found must contain, and "phrases" each must contain as a whole; the shell needs a phrase quoted again, as '"two words"' (Windows PowerShell 5.1: '\"two words\"', cmd.exe: "\"two words\""); without a query, every indexed file is listed

commands.name: index
commands.description: Bring the index up to date with the workspace; every workspace command does this first, so index is only needed for --rebuild

options.name: --rebuild
options.description: Re-read and re-parse every file, replacing the whole index

commands.name: init
commands.description: Make the current folder a workspace by writing a starter .hippo/config.json

commands.name: lint
commands.description: List broken links, frontmatter that fails to parse, and where OKF bundles depart from OKF v0.2; exits 1 when there are any findings

options.name: --rule
options.description: Only this rule, even one lint.off turns off; * matches any run of characters, as in okf-*; repeatable

commands.name: refs
commands.description: List the links out of a file, and whether each target exists

arguments.name: PATH
arguments.description: A file in the workspace, relative to the working directory

commands.name: show
commands.description: Show what the index holds for one file

arguments.name: PATH
arguments.description: A file in the workspace, relative to the working directory

commands.name: status
commands.description: Show the workspace root, database path, file counts and last sweep
